rss: Fed has 'work to do' if price rises don't ease for Americans, Warsh says
title: Why Prices Might Go Up
story: If things are costing too much, big decision-makers might change how fast money grows to stop prices from rising. This can affect how much you pay for your favorite toys and snacks.
storyBig: If inflation continues to be high, policymakers may consider increasing interest rates to control it. This could influence the cost of goods across various sectors, impacting consumer spending.
think: Have you noticed any prices going up at your local store?
bull: Learning how money supply affects prices can help us make better choices.
bear: If interest rates go up, it could make borrowing more expensive.

rss: Overcooked? Why robotic pizza makers are failing
title: Robot Pizza Makers Face Challenges
story: Pizza-making robots are having a tough time making perfect pizzas. People still like their pizzas made the old-fashioned way, by humans!
storyBig: Robotic pizza makers are encountering setbacks, as they struggle to deliver the quality and consistency expected by consumers. This shakes confidence in automation for pizza production.
think: Do you think robots could make your favorite meal just as well as a person?
bull: Automation can make things faster in the long run.
bear: Robots might not always get things right, especially with tricky tasks.
